summary: StudentPrerequisites manages and validates a comprehensive set of pre-placement requirements for students. These include immunizations (e.g., Measles, Mumps, Rubella, Covid19, Varicella, Hepatitis B), safety and infection control measures, confidentiality documentation, and other compliance tasks. The system tracks key dates, status codes, completion flags, and clinical notes, and provides robust validation logic against defined recency and content rules.
purpose: To ensure students meet all prerequisite requirements for placement activities, including medical, immunization, safety, and confidentiality standards, and to record and update their compliance status and related documentation.

workflows.name: Student Prerequisite Update
steps: Student/Staff/Administrator gathers required information (immunizations, mask fit, confidentiality forms, etc.)
Fill or update relevant fields in the StudentPrerequisite object
System validates field values (e.g., required dates, recency of immunizations, correct status codes)
If any validation fails, errors are returned with appropriate messages (e.g., 'Date more than 5 years', 'Required field missing')
If all validations pass, information is saved using related stored procedures (e.g., StudentDetailsImmunizationUpdate)
System updates completion flags and records

workflows.name: Student Confidentiality Handling
steps: Confidentiality form data is collected and date is recorded
System checks validity (e.g., form and received date required)
Updates are applied via StaffConfidentialityUpdate or StudentDetailsConfidentialityUpdate
Consent expiry and un-expiry are handled and reasons recorded

workflows.name: Immunization Validation
steps: For each immunization (by type), check for recency (usually not more than 5 years since administration)
Verify all required dates and result codes are present
Special validations (e.g., booster dates for Polio, expiry calculations for N95 mask fit)
Fail workflow if any rule not met, provide contextual error

business_rules: Immunizations and test results must be within defined recency thresholds (typically within 5 years)
Consent and confidentiality requirements must be fulfilled, including signatures, dates, and program associations
Fee and date fields must correspond if marked as paid
Certain fields (e.g., N95 mask size) require associated test dates if present
All required fields must be populated for successful update
validations: Dates are checked to ensure they are not greater than a configured maximum (usually 5 years back)
Year fields (e.g., for measles/varicella confirmation) are checked against valid ranges (MIN_YEAR to current year)
Required date fields must be filled if corresponding status fields are populated (e.g., N95 mask size requires a fit test date)
If expiry year is specified, expiry date must be entered
Programme and consent fields are mandatory; error if missing
Consent obtained date must be a valid date and not null
calculations: Expiry date calculations for N95 Mask, Tetanus, and others (e.g., N95 mask fit test expired if more than 5 years old or if expiry date is before completed date)
Display of expiry status for fields (e.g., red color if expired or about to expire)
Building formatted date strings for display
conditions: If immunization not marked as 'met' or missing required date, workflow is stopped and error returned
If medical or other prerequisite not completed, prevent further actions
Certain status codes result in special formatting or display logic
system_behavior: On update, system performs validation and saves data using procedures (e.g., StudentDetailsImmunizationUpdate, StudentDetailsSafetyUpdate)
Error messages presented if any rule or validation fails, with error contextual to field
Conditional field formatting (e.g., highlight/red text for expired or missing requirements)
Maintains audit and profile history for student prerequisite updates
dependencies: Resources for error messages and field descriptions
Related reference data for status codes, consent programs, mask codes, etc.
Stored procedures for updating data in the database
exceptions: Validation failure for date recency (e.g., immunization more than 5 years ago)
Missing required program or consent information
Invalid or null date fields where required
